name: OceanVP
description: A HYCOM-based spatiotemporal dataset and evaluation for predicting oceanic variables (e.g., currents, temperature) using relational spatiotemporal models.
reputation: A recent domain-specific dataset (2024) aimed at the oceanography modeling community; adoption is emerging but currently limited.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; uses HYCOM reanalysis data — may require substantial compute; potential spatial/temporal coverage biases and risk of overfitting to reanalysis patterns.
